name: meltemi
description: Read, triage, draft and schedule from your Meltemi mailbox. Runs the MCP server bundled with the Meltemi desktop app; what it may do is set in Meltemi's Settings → Agents.

mcp_path.title: meltemi-mcp location
mcp_path.description: Leave empty on macOS and on Linux .deb/.rpm installs. Otherwise paste the path shown in Meltemi → Settings → Agents.
